notes: ACCESS: plain direct fetch with a desktop Chrome UA, no bot protection, no proxy needed (as the prior Home-Decor pass in notes/30.md reported). TREE: pulled /sitemap-plp.xml (681 category URLs) and fetched every one of them, reading __NEXT_DATA__:props.pageProps.breadcrumbs off each page to rebuild the real parent chain; 530 of the 681 are true product listings (the other 151 are promo/brand/sale landing pages that carry no products or total and were discarded). Cross-checked against the site's own mega-nav (__NEXT_DATA__:props.pageProps.megaNav on the homepage) - the sitemap tree is strictly deeper than the nav (e.g. Dining Room > Cabinets & Hutches and all of the level-4 nodes are absent from the nav). COMPLETENESS: for all 138 nodes under the Furniture / Outdoor / Kids & Baby roots I sampled 2 pages of products and collected every category_info entry whose parent_id equals that node's id - i.e. the site's own child pointers. That found zero children missing from the sitemap tree, so the tree is complete and every row below is a true deepest node. Max tree depth on this site is 5. QTY: each listing page server-renders 'Results (N)' and the same integer sits at __NEXT_DATA__:props.pageProps.total. I captured both independently on all 530 listing pages and they were identical on every single one, so the rendered header IS the number recorded (the structured value is not a separate inflated population). Every leaf was then re-read twice more (three reads total, hours apart in-session) - zero drift on all 80 leaves. Each page's rel=canonical matched the URL fetched on all 530 pages, and each page's h1 matched the node name, so no silent parent-serving. The only cap-looking number on the site is the 10000 on the Furniture / Vintage / Pillows & Decor department roots - those are grouping rows here, never recorded as a qty. DUPLICATE TAXONOMY DROPPED: the site carries two parallel outdoor-furniture trees. Furniture > Outdoor Furniture (id 119603, with children 119639 Outdoor Lounge Furniture 748 / 119640 Outdoor Dining Furniture 809 / 119641 Outdoor Accent Tables & Chairs 976 / 119642 Hammocks & Porch Swings 31 / 119643 Umbrellas & Stands 66 / 119644 Storage & Covers 22) is a legacy mirror of Outdoor > Outdoor Furniture (id 101370). Products carry BOTH sets of ids in category_info; the mega-nav's own 'Outdoor Furniture' link (from both the Furniture tab and the Outdoor tab) points at 101370, and only the 101370 branch has level-4 children (Sofas & Loveseats, Chairs, Dining Tables, Club Chairs, ...). I therefore recorded the 101370 branch and dropped the 119603 mirror to avoid double-counting. SUBSET NODE DROPPED: Outdoor Furniture > Chairs (id 30000172, 350) is not in the nav and full enumeration of both nodes puts 312 of its 314 enumerable SKUs inside Lounge Furniture > Chairs (id 125633, 469, same name) - a re-cut, dropped. EXCLUDED as not furniture: Umbrellas & Stands (118838, 67 - patio umbrellas) and its 119603-tree twin; Entry > Umbrella Stands (119716, 11 - decorative porcelain/metal umbrella vessels, not furniture) so its parent Coat Racks & Umbrella Stands carries only Coat Racks; Entry > Pedestals (119719, 4 - opened it: decorative pedestal bowls, a pair of Drake decorative pedestals and a child's sled); Outdoor Accents > Fire Pits & Tables, Planters & Garden, Statuary & Fountains, Tabletop, Lanterns, Pillows & Throws, Beach Towels & Blankets; Outdoor Lighting and Outdoor Rugs & Doormats; the whole Pillows & Decor department (incl. Home Accents > Shelving & Brackets 127820 and Wallpaper & Accents > Shelving, Brackets & Hardware 119244 - wall shelving/brackets, Wall Decor's job; Baskets & Organization incl. its own Magazine Racks and Umbrella Stands - standalone storage goods; Trays & Boxes; Decorative Accents; Floral & Greenery; Picture Frames; Vases & Jars; Kitchen; Tabletop; Gifts & Accessories); the whole Bed & Bath department (bedding, towels, bath accessories - no bathroom furniture there, the bathroom vanities live under Furniture > Bathroom and are included); Rugs; Art & Mirrors (art and all mirrors incl. Floor Mirrors, per brief); Lighting; and all New Arrivals / Best-Sellers / Sale / Clearance / Ready to Ship / Vintage / One Kings Lane Collection / designer and brand landing pages (Vintage is a ?condition=vintage filter over the same categories, so vintage furniture is already inside these totals - no separate vintage rows taken). KIDS: the Kids & Baby department (121191) has a total of 2 - its only leaf, Toy Chests (121220), holds exactly 1 product and I opened it: it is 'S/2 Nina Column Table Lamps, Orange', a mis-tagged table lamp. There is no real kids/nursery furniture on this site, so no rows were taken from that branch. MATTRESSES: the site publishes no mattress category at all, so nothing to exclude. SIMILARLY-NAMED NODES KEPT: several names repeat as genuinely different listing pages under different parents and are all kept - Cabinets & Hutches (Living Room 119613 / Dining 119624), Bookcases & Etageres (Living Room 119612 group / Office 119619 leaf), Standard Benches and Storage Benches (Living Room 119663/119662 / Entry 119709/119708), Console Tables (Living Room 119610 / Entry 119712), Storage Furniture (Office 119669 / Entry 119707), Benches (Bedroom > End of Bed 119705), Dining Tables (indoor 119674 / outdoor 129039), Chairs / Club Chairs / Chaise Lounges / Ottomans / Poufs / Side Tables (indoor vs the outdoor 1256xx set). Four rows carry MANUAL REVIEW flags; see the flag text on each.
